title: Secondary-Relief Months (Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Arrangement Revisions)
content:
**Clause.** Secondary-relief months are taken off the remaining term of a revised Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement according to the secondary-payment entries posted on the account fewer than 3 whole calendar months before the handling date: at least 2 entries take off 2 months; at least 1 but fewer than 2 take off 1 month; fewer take off none.

| Secondary-payment entries in the last 3 whole calendar months | Months taken off |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 0 | 0 |

A secondary-payment entry is a payment by the patient's secondary coverage posted on this account against one of its charges; patient payments and adjustments are not counted.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Two secondary payments posted last month: 2 months off. One posted 2 whole months ago and one 3 whole months ago: only the first is in the window, 1 month off.
